messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock, so I can’t give you the exact minute‑by‑minute time right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time). If you know the current UTC time, subtract 4 or 5 hours (depending on whether DST is in effect) to get the local time in NYC.  

For the most accurate answer, check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock set to “New York,” or a time‑synchronization service.
